summary: This is a property that maps event classes to their listener classes. It's part of an event dispatcher system where when an event fires, the corresponding listeners in this array get executed. Right now the SampleListener is commented out, so nothing will happen when SampleEvent occurs.

explanations.1: The `protected` keyword means this property can only be accessed from within this class or its child classes, not from outside. The `$listen` variable will hold our event-to-listener mappings.
explanations.2: SampleEvent::class is a PHP syntax that gets the fully qualified class name as a string. It's a safe way to reference a class without having to type out the whole namespace.
